Course Information

  • Departure time: 12:30 – 13:00

  • Meeting point: After your reservation is confirmed, please provide your hotel address.

  • Duration: 5 – 8 hours

  • Drop-off location: Noi Bai International Airport (HAN) or your hotel

  • Places to visit: Hanoi Old House, Hoan Kiem Lake, Hanoi Church and Hanoi Train Track

Lunch Options

You may choose one of the following popular dishes for lunch:

  • Phở Lý Quốc Sư (Noodle soup – Ly Quoc Su Street)

  • Bún Chả – 01 Hàng Mành (Grilled pork with rice noodles – Hang Manh Street)

  • Bánh Cuốn – 12 Hàng Gà (Rolled steamed cake – Hang Ga Street)

Spa And Dinner

Spa Options

  • Labase Beauty Spa

  • Dalhye Beauty Spa

Dinner

Asian Fusion Set Menu at Koto Restaurant

– Starter –

  • Grilled Fish Crystal Rolls

  • US Beef Kumquat Salad

– Main Course –

  • Wok-fried Basil Chicken Thighs

  • BBQ Pork Spare Ribs

  • Stir-fried Seasonal Vegetables

  • Fragrant Steamed Rice

  • Soy Sauce Eggplant and Tofu

– Dessert –

  • Seasonal Fruit Platter

ONE DAY TRIP

Meal: Lunch, Dinner

12:30 The car and tour guide will pick you up at your hotel and take you for lunch with delicious Hanoi dishes such as Bún Chả, Phở, Bánh Cuốn, or Bánh Mì.

These are long-standing traditional specialties of Hanoi. Not only do local people love them, but international tourists and even world leaders visiting

Vietnam also look forward to having the chance to enjoy these dishes. They are not luxurious or expensive, but incredibly tasty and filled with the rich flavors of Vietnamese culinary culture.

13:30 Visit the Old Quarter with its ancient houses, hotels, restaurants, souvenir shops, and traditional market alleys. This is the busiest area of the city, where you will have the opportunity to learn about the daily life of Hanoi’s locals.

The next stop is the Ancient House at 87 Ma May Street. Built in the 19th century, this house represents Hanoi’s traditional architecture with an area of 157.6 m², along with many ancient artifacts still preserved inside, making it even more special.

14:30 Continue by car to visit the famous Train Track Coffee area. Enjoy a cup of coffee while admiring the railway line running between rows of ancient houses and crowds of visitors.

If you are lucky, you may see a train passing by—an unforgettable experience and a perfect chance to capture the typical cultural essence of Hanoi.

On the way to Hanoi Church, you will pass by many charming historical streets.

16:30 Arrive at the spa, where you will enjoy a 75-minute full-body massage at Labase Beauty Spa. This relaxing experience will leave you refreshed and energized for your night flight.

For customers who do not book the spa package, you will go directly to the restaurant for dinner.

18:00 Dinner will be served as a set menu at Koto Restaurant.

19:30 Depart for the airport.

20:15 Arrive at Noi Bai International Airport for your departure flight.

Includes

  • Car/bus for the entire tour & airport transfer

  • Lunch: Phở or Bún Chả or Bánh Mì or sticky rice + coffee (Choose 1 of the 3 main dishes + 1 free drink)

  • English/Japanese/Korean/Chinese-speaking guide

  • Dinner: Set menu at a famous restaurant

  • Spa: 75-minute full-body massage (Optional) / 50-minute hair wash

  • 1 bottle of water per person

Excludes

  • Personal entertainment expenses

  • Personal costs: phone charges, laundry

  • Tips for guide & driver (if customers are satisfied)

  • Any other services not mentioned in the itinerary
